name: ielts-general-preparation-course
title: IELTS General Preparation Course
short_introduction: This 7-hour online course focuses on developing the listening, reading and writing skills required for the exam, paired with in-person lessons focused on speaking, with the aim to help learners achieve their goal in the IELTS General exam.
description:
The online component of the course addresses the three skills that form the foundation of strong IELTS General Training performance. In Listening, you will develop an understanding of the different question types and four sections of the Listening test. The Listening test is identical across both Academic and General Training, so the strategies covered here are equally applicable whichever version of the test you are sitting.

In Reading, you will work through the question types most commonly tested in the General Training paper - including True/False/Not Given, matching headings, and sentence completion - learning how to approach the range of text types the General Training test uses. Unlike the Academic Reading paper, General Training texts include everyday materials such as advertisements, workplace notices, and official documents alongside longer, more complex passages, and the course prepares you for all of them.

In Writing, you will cover both compulsory tasks. Task 1 requires you to write a letter in response to a given situation - which may be formal, semi-formal, or informal in tone depending on the prompt. Task 2 requires you to write a well-argued essay in response to a point of view, argument, or problem, and you will develop the planning, structuring, and language skills to produce a coherent, well-supported response within the 40 minutes the exam allows.

The in-person speaking lessons work alongside the online content to prepare you for the three-part IELTS Speaking test. You will practise giving extended answers in the Part 1 interview, develop fluency and structure for the Part 2 long turn, and build the ability to discuss abstract ideas and justify opinions in the Part 3 discussion - the section that most strongly differentiates higher band scores. The Speaking test is identical across both Academic and General Training, so the strategies and practice in these sessions are directly transferable.

name: toeic
title: TOEIC 4-Skills Exam Preparation Course
short_introduction: This TOEIC preparation course is designed to help learners improve their English proficiency ahead of the Test of English for International Communication (TOEIC). The course focuses on developing the listening, reading, speaking and writing skills required for the TOEIC 4-skills exam, while also strengthening core English competencies.
description:
Course Objectives

  • Increase TOEIC score through targeted exam strategies.

  • Develop listening comprehension in professional contexts.

  • Strengthen grammar commonly tested in the exam.

  • Improve reading speed and accuracy.

  • Gain confidence in writing emails and opinion essays.

  • Gain confidence in speaking tasks, including reading texts aloud and responding to questions.

  • Expand business and workplace vocabulary.

name: english-b2
title: English B1
short_introduction: You and Me is a B2-level English course focused on real-life communication and meaningful interaction.
description:
In this course, learners will explore topics such as relationships, friendship, personal experiences, and everyday challenges, while developing the confidence to express opinions clearly and naturally.

Through listening, reading, speaking, and writing tasks, students will practice fluency and accuracy using more complex language structures and vocabulary. The course encourages reflection, discussion, and authentic communication, helping learners connect language to their own lives and experiences.
